name: prompt-610
image_vibe: Confident elegant black styling with intimate editorial attitude and minimal industrial studio setting
image_purpose: Create a polished fashion lookbook portrait with a strong dark silhouette.

prompt.project_info: An ultra-realistic studio portrait of an original adult woman seated sideways on a single metal chair.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman with long black wavy tousled hair tied in a high messy ponytail, a confident elegant expression, and direct intimate editorial eye contact. She wears an elegant black dress with thin straps and a low back, thigh-high patent leather boots, and a composed seated fashion pose.
prompt.composition_elements: Full-body or three-quarter framing, subject seated sideways on a metal chair with legs crossed and hands slightly raised, minimalist studio background, and the chair as the sole prop. Keep the dark dress and glossy boots as the visual silhouette anchors.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft yet defined professional studio light creating subtle shadows that model the face, dress texture, chair, and patent boots; confident, elegant, intimate-but-editorial mood without explicit framing.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic fashion photography, 85mm lens, f/4, realistic hair strands, dress, metal chair, leather, and skin texture, subtle film grain, natural optical falloff, high-resolution clarity, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-realistic full-body or three-quarter studio fashion portrait of an original adult woman with long black wavy tousled hair tied in a high messy ponytail, a confident elegant expression, and direct editorial eye contact. Seat her sideways on a single metal chair with her legs crossed and hands slightly raised. Dress her in an elegant black dress with thin straps and a low back, plus thigh-high patent leather boots. Use a minimalist studio background, soft yet defined professional lighting that creates subtle shadows across the face, dress, chair, and boots, an 85mm lens at f/4, realistic skin, hair, fabric, metal, and leather texture, subtle film grain, natural optical falloff, polished fashion-editorial clarity, and no text or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, minor or teen-coded subject, sexualized pose, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed chair, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text

assets.name: source black dress and patent boots portrait
assets.usage: Use only as optional guidance for the black dress, high ponytail, sideways chair pose, patent boots, and soft studio lighting; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the adult subject, black dress with low back, thigh-high patent boots, metal chair, crossed-leg seated pose, minimalist studio, and elegant editorial mood. Identity and non-essential details may vary.

changes: Clarified the subject as an original adult and framed the pose as editorial without changing the specified outfit or silhouette.
